# Panda CSS - Official Documentation Links
**Version:** 1.4.1  
**Homepage:** https://panda-css.com

## Core Concepts (Fetch These)

### Style Props (Most Important)
**URL:** https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/style-props  
**When:** Need to know all available CSS properties  
**Fetch command:**
```
Use web_fetch: https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/style-props
```

### Responsive Design
**URL:** https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/responsive-design  
**When:** Need breakpoint details or responsive patterns  
**Fetch command:**
```
Use web_fetch: https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/responsive-design
```

### Patterns
**URL:** https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/patterns  
**When:** Building layouts (stack, flex, grid)  
**Fetch command:**
```
Use web_fetch: https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/patterns
```

### Recipes
**URL:** https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/recipes  
**When:** Creating component variants  
**Fetch command:**
```
Use web_fetch: https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/recipes
```

## Usage Example for AI

```
TASK: Style a card component with hover effect

STEP 1: Read docs/vendor/panda-css/quick-reference.md
        (Get our tokens and patterns)

STEP 2: If needed, fetch official docs:
        web_fetch: https://panda-css.com/docs/concepts/style-props
        (Get full list of available properties)

STEP 3: Implement using our tokens and patterns
```
